latest_revision.scope: Second bounded weapon-only art/proportion revision; no baseline, gameplay, world lighting, tests, docs, git or sync changes.

validation.visual: NOT CLAIMED: rev6-courtyard.png was reviewed as input only; independent current-build art QA follows.
validation.muzzle_coordinate: Preserved by retaining root z scale 1.0, no root x offset/rotation, and y compensation root.position.y = 0.005 * (1 - root.scale.y).

attempts.outcome: Incomplete trailing source fragment; rejected without application
Complete source used as production candidate

producer.cost_note: CLI-reported cost, not independently verified billing. Haiku also appeared in CLI model usage; Fable was the requested producer.
producer.raw_output: Kept only in operating-system temporary storage; no reasoning, streams, account configuration or session identifiers copied into this repository

corrections: Preserve nonvisual gun children and original shared resources
Replace stacked receiver blocks with bevelled receiver side profiles; shorten and shape stock
Build actual open handguard vents and hollow ring-and-strut muzzle device
Open sight frame and add restrained transparent lens and separate red dot
Correct roughness map multiplication, texture filtering and material names
Replace finger/forearm orientation approximations with endpoint-aligned tapered geometry

After integrated rev2-hero.png review: remove low-frequency marbling, use subtle fine machining and subdued fabric weave, set receiver roughness to approximately 0.55-0.57, narrow visual root while preserving bore coordinates
After actual rev3-hero.png and rev4-hero.png review: reduce foreground dominance by changing visual root scale to 0.62 x 0.78 x 1.0 with bore-y compensation while keeping muzzle endpoint z unchanged
Shorten and slim the near-camera stock/buttpad/buffer tube; reduce pistol grip, magazine and visible hands/forearms so the carbine sits lower-right instead of filling the foreground
Rework receiver and handguard into slimmer AR-carbine proportions with bevelled profiles, smaller rail teeth, darker vent recesses and reduced barrel/muzzle diameters
Retune material albedo/roughness/metalness so steel, receiver metal, matte polymer and glove materials separate under parent world lighting
After actual rev6-courtyard.png review: remove the visible square stock/buttpad entirely from the first-person frame and leave only a short receiver extension/buffer detail
Extend the left support sleeve downward and toward the near-camera side so its capped end should exit the bottom of the frame instead of floating inside the image
Increase both hands modestly after rev6 showed them undersized relative to the weapon

Reduce blue-tinted slab read by shifting receiver/barrel/polymer colors toward neutral worn gunmetal and adding explicit local bevel strips, pins, ports and edge highlights instead of relying on broad random texture variation
